status: technical feasibility input only; not art; not approved; not runtime

master.role: PROVISIONAL technical input. The user has not chosen BOX vs LANCZOS vs neither; this experiment may be discarded.

conventions.coordinates: cell texels, x right, y down, rects are [x0, y0, x1, y1] inclusive
conventions.vl: viewer-left (the character's right side; knee-guard leg, scarf tail, ponytail tuft)
conventions.bob: whole-body integer y offset in texels, positive = down
conventions.foot_row: lowest opaque row of that leg in the baked frame
conventions.shin_delta: rows inserted (+, duplicated copies) or removed (-) inside the leg's shin band; derived as foot_row - idle_foot_row - bob and re-checked by the bake
conventions.swing_x: integer x offset applied to leg rows from the shin-band midpoint downward (lifted foot tucks toward the centre line)

layer_masks.order_note: Rules are applied in this order to opaque master texels; the first match owns the texel. Every opaque texel gets exactly one owner.
layer_masks.skin_row_enclosed: skin texels in the rect, plus any opaque texel lying between the leftmost and rightmost skin texel of the same row (eyes, brows, mouth)

knee_guard.declared_side: viewer-left: centroid x < ground_pin x and all texels owned by leg_vl

ponytail.declared_side: viewer-left of the head: centroid x < face_head centroid x

occlusion_fill.rule: each arm_vr footprint texel takes the colour of the nearest torso_coat texel to its left in the same master row; placed with the body bob; visible only where arm_vr has moved away
occlusion_fill.classification: synthesized fill (copied colour, displaced position); counted separately from hand edits

scarf_tail_sway.note: integer x offset for scarf_tail rows >= 73 (free-hanging tip only)

pilot_motion.speed_note: isolated experiment value only; NOT a game runtime decision (memo R2 still open)

arm_vl_note: viewer-left hand grips the bag strap in the master; it moves only with the body bob (no swing)
ponytail_note: rides rigidly with the head (bob only); no lag, so no hair junction is opened
